## Research question

- Which marketing activities are associated with weekly sales?

## Model

- Outcome: sales
- Predictors: advertising, discount, competitor conditions
- Each coefficient is conditional on included predictors

## Interpretation

- Original units matter
- Report estimate and confidence interval
- Avoid causal language without a causal design

## Diagnostics

- Linearity
- Residual pattern and spread
- Multicollinearity
- Influential observations

## Judgement

- An unusual week is a question to investigate—not a case to delete automatically
